OSSL v1.2 Raw Spectra
(19,746 KSSL + 3,473 ICRAF)

crops.json (25 FAO EcoCrop Profiles)
crops_local.json (ICAR Overrides)

diseases.json (26 Disease Etiologies)
class_map.json (28 Mapped Classes)

Bayesian Inference Engine (src/edaphnet2/inference.py)
• Exact Batch MAP Log-Likelihood ell(j, i)
• Marginal Swap Posterior P(moved)
• Marginal Value Posterior P(val_err)

Structured Permutation Subgroup S_tray (src/edaphnet2/swaps.py)
• 281 Hypotheses (n=24): S0(Id), S1(Adj), S2(Shift), S3(Pair)

Typed Corruption Library C (src/edaphnet2/operators.py)
• Decimal (x10, /10), Unit, Transposition, ColSwap, Gross

Conformal Calibration & FDR Control (src/edaphnet2/conformal.py)
• De-duplicated Split-Conformal Calibration
• Benjamini-Hochberg FDR Control (q=0.10)
• Covariate Shift Density-Ratio Weighting

Combined Re-Test Policy (src/edaphnet2/combined_policy.py)
• P1: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
• P2: 50/50 Swap/Value Budget Split

Leaf Disease Classifier (app/leaf/model.py)
• Backbone: Frozen MobileNetV3-Large (960-d)
• Head: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression (C=0.1)
• Post-Hoc NLL Temperature Scaling (T=0.797)
• Abstention Gate: Threshold tau = 0.50

Soil Property Witness Brain (models/colour_brain_*.joblib)
• Multi-Output LightGBM Regressors
• Phone Noise Data Augmentation (dE=2)
• LatentTransform (Log, Logit, Standardization)

Witness Ladder Regressors (scripts/fit_witness_ladder.py)
• 5 Rungs: W0, W1(dE 0,2,4,8), W2, W3
• 5-Fold GroupKFold OOF Residual Covariance S

Physical Colorimetry (src/edaphnet2/phone.py)
• 24-Patch ColorChecker Grid Interpolation
• Root-Polynomial Degree-2 CCM Fitting
• CIE DeltaE00 Calibration Residual
• Laplacian Blur & Pixel Clipping Checks

Spectral Witness Engine (src/edaphnet2/real_data.py)
• CIE 1931 2° / D65 Spectral Integration
• Reflectance to CIELAB (L*, a*, b*)
• Vis-NIR W3 SVD/PCA-30 Embedding

🔓 Open Access / Unauthenticated
(Designed for field farmers & offline research)

Image Decoder & Validator

(Lazy Loader with Error Caching)

Multi-Soil pH Range Scenario Averager
